data.title: Union Saint-Gilloise vs Real Sociedad - prediction, preview & betting tips - 15/10/2026
data.content:
The Belgian Pro League giants will be without the injured Kevin Mac Allister (cruciate ligament), while Massire Sylla's availability is questionable. Zorgane Adem, Van De Perre Kamiel, and Florucz Raul Alexander are all suspended for this fixture.

Union SG are expected to field a similar starting XI to the one that crushed Viktoria Plzen 3-0 in their Europa League opener, with Mateo Biondic and Relebohile Mofokeng featuring up front. [...] Unlike their opponents, the visitors kicked off their Europa League campaign with a defeat, falling 2-1 at home to Bournemouth. They will be without Jon Aramburu (muscle), Luken Beitia (sprained ankle), and long-term absentee defender Alvaro Odriozola (ACL).

This will be the first encounter between these sides. Interestingly, Real Sociedad have never beaten a Belgian outfit (D1, L2), while Union SG have lost their only clash with a Spanish side. [...] On the other hand, Real Sociedad are coming off a 3-2 victory over Deportivo La Coruna. Leading 3-0 by the 54th minute, the Basque side saw their margin trimmed to one within 15 minutes, but held firm despite a late red card.

Pellegrino Matarazzo's men have not been particularly consistent of lat, having won three and lost two of their last five competitive fixtures. Interestingly, all three victories during that stretch were by the same 3-2 scoreline.
